title: PR queue eligibility observation
description: Historical pre-selection evidence, never authorization to claim or merge. Runtime additionally verifies unique PR identities, exact count arithmetic, claim-state consistency and a 4 MiB byte bound.

gaggle.description: Gaggle namespace; empty denotes legacy unscoped execution.

observedAt.description: Selection observation time, not a claim freshness guarantee.

completeSnapshot.description: Whether provider coverage was complete; distinct from report truncation.

matchingItems.description: Count of PRs matching the workflow's responsibility scope.

omittedItems.description: Observed matching PRs omitted from this bounded report.

items.description: Bounded per-PR observations in selector order.

eligible.description: Passed selection policy; does not imply claim availability.

reason.description: Selector's first decisive exclusion reason, absent when eligible.

nextStep.description: Conservative operator guidance for this policy decision.

state.description: Local ledger observation, not global claim authority.

expiresAt.description: Recorded lease expiry, compared at observation time.

providerClaimLabel.description: Presence of the provider-visible claimed label in the snapshot.

comparison.description: Factual comparison; disagreement never authorizes removing a marker.

nextStep.description: Conservative next step that preserves claim ownership.
